levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: Harthama's account has two speakers: Subayh tells him the plot («قال لي صبيح»), then the Imam speaks at the end («فلما رآني قال يا هرثمة»); both are kept in text order, the Imam last (ruling 5)
«يعني الرضا» is a gloss on the Imam's name, the Caliph's scene is not a link; «رضي الله عنه» is removed
